entities.name: Harith Ibn Hilliza Ul-Yashkuri
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Ḥārith ibn Ḥilliza al-Yashkurī was a pre-Islamic Arabian poet of the tribe of Bakr, from the 5th century. He was the author of one of the seven famous pre-Islamic poems known as the Mu'allaqat. Little is known of the details of his life.
